item.title: Why Seammetry
item.description:
Today, the $90-billion ocean freight container market is broken.

For such a large and crucial market for the world economy, its trading mechanisms are prehistoric. This is especially so given the fact that other industries have made trading conditions much more efficient, balanced and transparent.

Seammetry ensures that the ocean freight container market is less volatile and more reliable.

With Seammetry, the market becomes more stable and more dependable.
